description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka West, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530175
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
